description: This file defines logging configuration functions for the Mattermost server, including log file paths, log root validation, and configuration generation for console and file logging targets.

methods.name: MloggerConfigFromLoggerConfig
methods.description: Creates a logger configuration based on provided log settings and source configuration.

methods.name: MloggerConfigFromAuditConfig
methods.description: Creates a logger configuration for audit logging based on audit settings.

methods.name: GetLogFileLocation
methods.description: Returns the full path to the log file, defaulting to the 'logs' directory if no location is specified.

methods.name: GetLogRootPath
methods.description: Returns the root directory for all log files, based on environment variable or default logs directory.

methods.name: ValidateLogFilePath
methods.description: Validates that a log file path is within the allowed logging root directory.

methods.name: WarnIfLogPathsOutsideRoot
methods.description: Logs warnings if log file paths in configuration are outside the logging root directory.

methods.name: validateAdvancedLoggingConfig
methods.description: Validates individual logging targets in advanced logging configuration JSON.

methods.name: makeSimpleConsoleTarget
methods.description: Creates a console logging target configuration.

methods.name: makeSimpleFileTarget
methods.description: Creates a file logging target configuration.

methods.name: stdLevels
methods.description: Converts a string log level to a list of mlog.Levels up to that level.

methods.name: stringToStdLevel
methods.description: Converts a string log level to an mlog.Level.

methods.name: makeJSONFormatOptions
methods.description: Creates JSON format options for logging.

methods.name: makePlainFormatOptions
methods.description: Creates plain text format options for logging.

methods.name: makeFileOptions
methods.description: Creates file options JSON for log file configuration.
